newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER SHOWCASE-PATH TO THE F.A. CUP FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-PATH TO THE F.A. CUP FINAL.

text.p: Chelsea and Middlesbrough played
the following matches on their way to the F.A. Cup Final at
Wembley:
Chelsea
Round 3 West Bromwich Albion H W 3-0 Wise, Burley, Zola
Round 4 Liverpool H W 4-2 Hughes, Zola, Vialli 2
Round 5 Leicester City A D 2-2 Di Matteo, Hughes
Round 5r Leicester City H W 1-0 Leboeuf (pen)
Round 6 Portsmouth A W 4-1 Hughes, Zola, Wise 2
Semifinal Wimbledon W 3-0 Hughes 2, Zola
(played at Highbury)
Scorers: Mark Hughes 5, Gianfranco Zola 4, Dennis Wise 3,
Gianluca Vialli 2, Craig Burley 1, Roberto di Matteo 1, Frank
Leboeuf 1. Total: 17
Middlesbrough
Round 3 Chester City H W 6-0 Ravanelli 2, Hignett,Cox, Beck, Stamp
Round 4 Hednesford Town A* W 3-2 Lambert og, Fjortoft,
(match played at Middlesbrough) Ravanelli
Round 5 Manchester City A W 1-0 Juninho
Round 6 Derby County A W 2-1 Juninho, Ravanelli
Semifinal Chesterfield D 3-3 Ravanelli, Hignett
(pen), Festa
(played at Old Trafford)
Semifinal Chesterfield W 3-0 Beck, Ravanelli,
Emerson
Replay (played at Hillsborough)
Scorers: Fabrizio Ravanelli 6, Juninho 2, Craig Hignett 2,
Mikkel Beck 2, Neil Cox 1, Phil Stamp 1, Jan-Age Fjortoft 1,
Gianluca Festa 1, Emerson 1, own goal 1. Total: 18
